specs.Item Type Name: Tronica PS07 Premium Series 7.1 Digital 60W Bluetooth Home Theater System PenDrive FM Aux TV Compatible with All Function Remote

features: BLUETOOTH WIRELESS STREAMING: Stream music easily from your smartphone, tablet, laptop, MP3 player, or compatible Smart TV using Bluetooth connectivity. Enjoy wireless playback from music apps, videos, movies, and playlists without the hassle of extra wires

FM RADIO WITH BETTER RECEPTION: Listen to your favourite FM radio stations directly on the speaker and enjoy quick access to local music, news, and entertainment channels. For improved FM range and clarity, extend the antenna wire properly for better signal reception

REMOTE & EASY CONTROL PANEL: Control your speaker conveniently with the wireless remote or the built-in control buttons on the subwoofer unit. Scan FM channels, play or pause music, change tracks, search forward or backward, switch modes, and adjust volume with ease

4 PRESET EQUALIZER MODES: The built-in equalizer offers 4 preset sound modes, allowing you to adjust the audio output based on your listening preference. Choose the right mode for music, movies, vocals, or bass-heavy tracks for a more customized sound experience

MULTIMEDIA HOME ENTERTAINMENT SPEAKER: Designed for daily entertainment, this Bluetooth home theater speaker works well for movies, music, TV audio, FM radio, gaming, and party playlists. It delivers clear vocals, balanced sound, and enjoyable bass for living rooms, bedrooms, and indoor gatherings

7.1 CHANNEL SURROUND SOUND SYSTEM: Features immersive 360-degree acoustics with seven satellite speakers and one subwoofer unit, delivering theater-like audio experience with crisp vocals, detailed mids, and powerful bass for an enhanced home entertainment setup

PREMIUM WOODEN CABINET DESIGN: Constructed with sturdy wooden cabinet featuring high-gloss UV finish that ensures durability while adding an elegant and luxurious aesthetic to your living room, bedroom, or entertainment space with space-saving compact structure
